messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: In the Mounjaro prescribing information, SURPASS-1 (NCT03954834) was a 40-week trial in adults with type 2 diabetes whose blood sugar was not adequately controlled with diet and exercise alone. Patients received once-weekly Mounjaro 5 mg, 10 mg, or 15 mg, or placebo.
After 40 weeks, 78% to 85% of adults taking Mounjaro achieved an HbA1c below 7%, compared with 23% of adults taking a placebo.
The average HbA1c change was -1.8% with Mounjaro 5 mg, -1.7% with Mounjaro 10 mg, and -1.7% with Mounjaro 15 mg, compared with -0.1% with placebo.
Triplet: ["placebo", "has trial result", "average HbA1c change -0.1%"]

The relation 'has trial result' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject treatment or intervention is associated with the outcome or result specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'has effect': The subject drug produces the therapeutic or physiological effect specified by the object entity.
B. 'has study result': The studies related to the subject drug have found the result specified by the object entity.
C. 'may cause': The subject action or condition can lead to or contribute to the development of the medical condition or effect specified by the object entity.
D. 'has treatment for side effect': The subject drug's side effect can be treated or managed by the method or substance specified by the object entity.
E. 'occur with or without': The subject condition or phenomenon can happen in the presence or absence of the factor or intervention specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
